messages.author: 839eb4092a42aa65
messages.subject: Re: upgrade to Rstan 1.3.0
parts:
I was having similar issues installing rstan 1.3 on Windows 7, but I fixed it by changing the O0 to O3 in my makevars file in C:\Users\Jeff\Documents\.R, it's on the line that starts with CXXFLAGS

Jeff

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: upgrade to Rstan 1.3.0
parts:
On Sunday, May 5, 2013 1:42:24 AM UTC-4, Irene wrote:
I am trying to upgrade the Rstan from the old version, to the most current version (12th, April), But I have encountered this error after removing the old package, and installed the new package. Do I need to upgrade the Rtool as well ? thanks,
 
 
g++  -I"C:/R/R-215~1.2/include" -DDEBUG   -I"../inst/include/stansrc"   -I"../inst/include/stanlib/eigen_3.1.2"  -I"../inst/include/stanlib/eigen_3.1.2/unsupported"  -I"../inst/include/stanlib/boost_1.53.0"  -I"../inst/include"  -DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS   -I"C:/R/R-2.15.2/library/Rcpp/include"      -O0 -Wall  -mtune=core2 -g   -c stanc.cpp -o stanc.o

Somehow, your system is appending -mtune=core2 and -g which make the files much bigger and generally are not necessary. These may be added because you have something to that effect in $HOME/.R/Makevars or a system configuration file.

Ben

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: upgrade to Rstan 1.3.0
parts:
The reason might be that you have used set_cppo("debug"), but not followed by set_cppo('fast'). 

For installing rstan, you can remove file $HOME/.R/Makevars so that the default settings in rstan's makefiles will take over. 

--
Jiqiang
